summary: Eva Live Inc. filed an 8-K on June 16, 2026, announcing the formation of a wholly owned subsidiary, Eva Defense Inc., to pursue acquisitions and partnerships in drone and defense technology. No specific deal terms, stake, price, or premium were disclosed. The board recommended the strategic initiative, though no advisors were named. The subsidiary will focus on acquiring companies with proprietary technologies in autonomous systems and defense. The filing is a forward-looking strategic announcement rather than a definitive special situation. To watch: whether Eva Defense identifies specific targets or completes any transactions.
